newsitem.title: USA: Conn. Foxwoods says slot machine revs up four pct.
newsitem.headline: Conn. Foxwoods says slot machine revs up four pct.

text.p: NEW YORK, Feb 5 (Reuter) The Foxwoods Resort Casino in Connecticut said slot revenues rose four percent in January against the year-ago period.

Foxwoods President Michael Brown said the state received $11.4 million from January's slot machine total of $45.7 million. Connecticut receives 25 percent of the revenue for giving the Mashantucket Pequot tribe permission to operate the machines.
State officials have estimated a $199.3 million profit from both the Mashantucket Pequot and the Mohegan Sun casinos for the fiscal year ending June 30th.
